## Staffing Future & Adzuna


Adzuna is a comprehensive online job search platform that offers numerous benefits to both job seekers and employers. With its extensive database of job listings and innovative features, Adzuna provides a valuable resource for efficient and effective job searches. Here are some key advantages of using Adzuna.

Extensive Job Listings: Adzuna aggregates job listings from multiple sources, including job boards, company websites, and recruitment agencies. This vast database provides job seekers with a wide range of job opportunities across various industries, locations, and job types.

Advanced Search Filters: Adzuna offers advanced search filters that allow job seekers to refine their job search based on specific criteria such as job title, location, salary range, and contract type. This helps job seekers find relevant positions that match their preferences and qualifications, saving time and effort.

Salary Insights: Adzuna provides salary insights for job listings, giving job seekers a better understanding of the salary range for a particular role. This information helps job seekers make informed decisions about potential job opportunities and negotiate their salary expectations.

Easy Application Process: Adzuna simplifies the job application process by allowing job seekers to apply to job listings directly through the platform. Job seekers can upload their resumes, cover letters, and other necessary documents, making it convenient and efficient to submit applications.

Email Job Alerts: Adzuna offers email job alerts that notify job seekers about new job postings matching their search criteria. Job seekers can customize their job alerts based on their preferences and receive timely notifications about relevant job opportunities.

Company Insights: Adzuna provides insights into companies, including detailed company profiles, employee reviews, and ratings. Job seekers can gain valuable information about a company’s culture, work environment, and employee experiences, helping them make informed decisions about potential employers.

Career Resources and Advice: Adzuna offers a range of career resources and advice articles to support job seekers in their job search and professional development. These resources include resume writing tips, interview guidance, career advice, and industry insights, helping job seekers improve their job search strategies and enhance their skills.

Mobile Accessibility: Adzuna offers mobile applications for iOS and Android devices, allowing job seekers to search and apply for jobs on the go. The mobile app provides flexibility and convenience, enabling job seekers to access their accounts, receive job alerts, and submit applications anytime, anywhere.

Cost-effective for Employers: Adzuna provides cost-effective pricing options for employers to post job listings and reach a wide audience of job seekers. Employers can effectively promote their job vacancies and connect with potential candidates without breaking their recruitment budget.

Data-driven Insights for Employers: Adzuna offers data-driven insights and analytics for employers, allowing them to track the performance of their job listings and recruitment campaigns. Employers can measure metrics such as views, applications, and hires, enabling them to optimize their hiring strategies and make data-driven decisions.

In summary, Adzuna offers extensive job listings, advanced search filters, salary insights, easy application process, email job alerts, company insights, career resources and advice, mobile accessibility, cost-effectiveness for employers, and data-driven insights. These benefits make Adzuna a valuable platform for job seekers and employers, facilitating successful job matches and efficient hiring processes.

# Adzuna Acquires 2 Job Search Engines







Read Time 2 Minute, 32 Second



Adzuna , the global job search platform, today announced the acquisition of the jobs businesses of Trovit and Mitula, two market-leading search engines operated by the  Lifull Connect group . The acquisition marks Adzuna’s third acquisition in four years, further strengthening its position as one of the world’s leading global job search platforms.

Founded in 2006, Trovit and Mitula operate in more than 50 countries, centralising thousands of classified ads spanning jobs, real estate, and cars, with a strong presence in key European and international markets.

The acquisition exemplifies Adzuna’s ongoing commitment to help people find better, more fulfilling jobs, while strengthening its footprint in high-growth international markets including Spain and Italy. For Trovit and Mitula Jobs’ global user base, the Adzuna acquisition brings continuity but also introduces a smarter job search experience through its groundbreaking AI search technology and  a suite of AI tools . For employers, the acquisition brings a wider audience and more quality applications worldwide.

Trovit and Mitula’s jobs verticals are now fully integrated into Adzuna. Existing job sites have been automatically redirected to Adzuna, and Trovit and Mitula subscribers have received direct communication and step-by-step guidance to ensure a smooth transfer of saved searches and job alerts.

Doug Monro, CEO and co-founder of  Adzuna  comments,  “ We are excited to welcome users from the Trovit Jobs and Mitula Jobs to the Adzuna group. This acquisition represents a significant step forward in our strategy to grow our global portfolio and deliver smarter job search at scale. The acquisition of the Trovit and Mitula job verticals give us the ability to connect millions of extra jobseekers in Europe, the US, Asia and Latin America with the right opportunities using our AI search and tools, delivering even more high quality matches and greater hiring efficiency for employers.

In the age of AI, while AI itself may not replace jobs, jobseekers who harness new tools effectively will hold a clear advantage over those who don’t. By offering a suite of  free market-leading AI tools  that streamline job search, we empower jobseekers to make better-informed career decisions and navigate the job search process with greater confidence. We look forward to helping jobseekers discover better, more fulfilling job search experiences on Adzuna .”

See also   Glassdoor Launches Diversity & Inclusion Products



Carlos Ruiz Comes, Vertical Search General Manager from Lifull Connect comments, “ Adzuna has established itself as a global leader in online job search, and I firmly believe that Trovit Jobs and Mitula Jobs users will benefit from Adzuna’s technology and recruitment expertise and continue to grow and innovate under Adzuna’s leadership. As Lifull Connect sharpens its strategic focus on our successful real estate marketplaces, it was important for us to find the right player in the jobs space, and Adzuna is the best home for such job verticals. Adzuna offers the scale, AI expertise and strategic alignment to take the business  forward, and we look forward to seeing them thrive as part of the Adzuna group .”

Adzuna job search engine finds vacancies from hundreds of different job boards and employers and shows them to jobseekers in one place. We can save you hours spent on job hunting on various sites and helping you find your perfect job match. Let us do the hard work!

FILTERS FOR FINDING THE PERFECT JOB
You can filter search results to find the perfect job ranging from internships, graduate, student jobs, junior, intermediate to senior and management roles. Your career development is in safe hands with Adzuna job search app: select your location, type of contract, if you want to work full-time or part-time and what salary you’re expecting. Find the best job matches for your next career move!

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITE JOBS
If you like a job – save it in your favourites and get back to it later when you’re ready to apply. Keep all the jobs you like in one place, so you don’t have to remember where you saw them.

PERSONALIZED JOB ALERTS
You can set up personalized job alerts with Adzuna to never miss a new job opportunity. We will send you a daily push notification when new jobs that match your criteria become available. You can create job alerts for different searches with no limitations and we’ll always keep you updated with the latest vacancies.

HOW TO FIND YOUR DREAM JOB WITH ADZUNA
Finding a new job with Adzuna is really easy and 100% free with no annoying ads:

1. Install the Adzuna job search app
2. Search for jobs: enter a job title and your location
3. Find jobs you like
4. Use filters to refine your search
5. Check out the jobs you like with just one tap or save them to your favourites
6. Apply and please tell us when you get the job, we’d love to hear about your success!

You have thousands of opportunities at your fingertips with Adzuna no matter what job you’re looking for – we’ve got you covered from junior to senior roles, remote working, part-time and full-time, fixed term contracts and freelance gigs. Start your jobs search with Adzuna!

ADZUNA JOB SEARCH FEATURES
* Search millions of jobs from hundreds of websites
* Filter by salary, industry and contract type
